name: Ith, High Arcanist
blocked_sentences: {T}: Untap target attacking creature. Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by that creature this turn.

needs.what: a `combat_only` flag on the `prevent_damage_permanent` op (and the PermanentShield it installs), so a resolving ability can prevent only COMBAT damage dealt to and by one targeted permanent this turn, leaving noncombat damage to and from it unprevented
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `prevent_damage_permanent` with `dealt: "to_and_by"` and `duration: "this_turn"` is the exact shape but its shield stops all damage, so the creature would also be immune to burn and its own noncombat damage would be prevented -- a strictly different card. The `combat_only` flag the engine just gained lives only on the `prevent_damage` STATIC, which cannot be installed by an activated ability, has no duration and only faces 'dealt to'.
